source.text: Κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ἦλθον οὐ καθ’ ὑπεροχὴν λόγου ἢ σοφίας καταγγέλλων ὑμῖν τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And I, having come to you, brothers, came not according to superiority of word or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of the God.

en.L: And I, when I came to you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, did not come with superiority of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
en.B: For my part, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, when I came to you and announced God's testimony to you, I did not come with impressive speech or superior wisdom.
en.R: It was the same with me, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}. When I came to you, I came to tell you what God has done. But I did not try to impress you with fine speeches or clever ideas.

fr.L: Et moi, quand je suis venu chez vous, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je ne suis pas venu avec une supériorité de parole ou de sagesse, en vous annonçant le témoignage de Dieu.
fr.B: Pour ma part, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, quand je suis venu chez vous vous annoncer le témoignage de Dieu, je ne suis pas venu avec des discours impressionnants ou une sagesse supérieure.
fr.R: Il en a été de même pour moi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}. Quand je suis venu chez vous, je suis venu vous dire ce que Dieu a fait. Mais je n’ai pas cherché à vous impressionner avec de beaux discours ou des idées habiles.

sw.L: Nami, nilipokuja kwenu, ndugu, sikuja kwa ubora wa maneno au wa hekima, nikiwatangazia ushuhuda wa Mungu.
sw.B: Kwa upande wangu, ndugu, nilipokuja kwenu na kuwatangazia ushuhuda wa Mungu, sikuja na maneno ya kuvutia wala hekima ya hali ya juu.
sw.R: Ndivyo ilivyokuwa kwangu pia, ndugu. Nilipokuja kwenu, nilikuja kuwaambia yale ambayo Mungu ametenda. Lakini sikujaribu kuwavutia kwa hotuba nzuri wala mawazo ya ujanja.

es.L: Y yo, cuando fui a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hermanos, no fui con superioridad de palabra o de sabiduría, {{plural_you:anunciándoles|anunciándoos}} el testimonio de Dios.
es.B: Por mi parte, hermanos, cuando fui a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}} y {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié el testimonio de Dios, no llegué con discursos impresionantes ni con una sabiduría superior.
es.R: Lo mismo pasó conmigo, hermanos. Cuando fui a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}}, fui a {{plural_you:contarles|contaros}} lo que Dios ha hecho. Pero no traté de {{plural_you:impresionarlos|impresionaros}} con discursos elegantes ni con ideas ingeniosas.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, về phần tôi, khi tôi đến với anh chị em, tôi đã không đến với lời nói hay sự khôn ngoan trổi hơn mà công bố cho anh chị em lời chứng của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, về phần tôi, khi đến với anh chị em và công bố lời chứng của Đức Chúa Trời, tôi đã không đến với lời lẽ hùng hồn hay sự khôn ngoan vượt trội.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi cũng vậy. Khi đến với anh chị em, tôi đến để nói cho anh chị em biết những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm. Nhưng tôi không tìm cách gây ấn tượng với anh chị em bằng những bài diễn văn hay hoặc những ý tưởng khéo léo.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나도 여러분에게 갔을 때에, 말이나 지혜의 뛰어남으로 여러분에게 하나님의 증언을 전하러 가지 않았습니다.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나도 여러분에게 가서 하나님의 증언을 전할 때에, 사람을 감동시키는 말솜씨나 뛰어난 지혜를 가지고 가지 않았습니다.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나도 마찬가지였습니다. 나는 여러분에게 가서 하나님께서 하신 일을 전했습니다. 그러나 멋진 연설이나 똑똑한 생각으로 여러분에게 좋은 인상을 주려고 하지 않았습니다.

decisions.choice: and I: Paul's own arrival among them followed the same pattern as God's choice of the Corinthians
alternatives: a simple new start with no link to what goes before
decisions.reason: Κἀγὼ ("and I") ties what Paul now says about himself to 1:26-31: God chose what the world counts foolish and weak, and Paul came to them in the same way. It also takes up 1:17, where he says Christ sent him to preach the gospel not with clever speech.

decisions.choice: fellow believers, women and men
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοί addresses the whole church in Corinth, which included women such as Chloe's household (1:11) and Prisca (16:19; Acts 18:2).

decisions.choice: superiority of speech or wisdom: the polished speaking and clever argument that won an audience's admiration
alternatives: a position of authority over them
decisions.reason: ὑπεροχὴν means rising above, excelling. λόγου here is speaking, the speaker's skill, not "the word" of the gospel. In Greek cities public speakers gathered admirers by style and argument, and some in Corinth were comparing preachers in just this way (1:12; 2 Corinthians 10:10). Paul refused to compete on those terms.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "testimony"
decisions.reason: Some early manuscripts read μυστήριον ("mystery") instead of μαρτύριον ("testimony"); the two words look alike in Greek. "Mystery" would anticipate verse 7, and "testimony" echoes 1:6, "the testimony of Christ". The SBLGNT prints "testimony". Either way Paul means the message he brought them. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the testimony of God: the message that bears witness to what God has done in Christ
decisions.reason: The genitive could name the one who testifies or the one testified about. In 1:6 "the testimony of Christ" is the witness about Christ, and verse 2 says what the witness was about: Jesus Christ crucified. The message also comes from God, so the two senses are close.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Paul is addressing the whole church, women and men; the traditional form is the alternative.

decisions.choice: superiority of speech or of wisdom (L); impressive speech or superior wisdom (B); fine speeches or clever ideas (R)
decisions.reason: "Excellency" is archaic. Balanced and Readable say what the phrase describes (m3): speaking meant to impress.

decisions.choice: It was the same with me; what God has done
alternatives: And I; the testimony of God
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the link to 1:26-31 (m1) and what the testimony was about (m5).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:anunciándoles|anunciándoos}}; {{plural_you:verlos|veros}}
decisions.reason: Where the plural "you" is joined to the end of a verb, the two Spanish forms differ in the ending, so the span covers the whole verb, as in Romans 1:11 ("{{plural_you:verlos|veros}}").

decisions.choice: "말이나 지혜의 뛰어남" (L); "사람을 감동시키는 말솜씨나 뛰어난 지혜" (B); "멋진 연설이나 똑똑한 생각" (R)
alternatives: "말씀", the word for the gospel message
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as the speaker's skill, not the word of the gospel, so Korean says "말" and "말솜씨", keeping "말씀" for God's message.

source.text: οὐ γὰρ ἔκρινά τι εἰδέναι ἐν ὑμῖν εἰ μὴ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν καὶ τοῦτον ἐσταυρωμένον·

records.literal_gloss: For not I decided anything to know among you except Jesus Christ and this [one] having been crucified;

en.L: For I decided not to know anything among you except Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, and {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} crucified.
en.B: My decision was this: while I was among you, the only thing I would know was Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as the one who was crucified.
en.R: While I was with you, I decided that the only thing I would think and talk about was Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} died on the cross.

fr.L: Car j’ai décidé de ne rien savoir parmi vous, sinon Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} crucifié.
fr.B: Voici ce que j’avais décidé : tant que je serais parmi vous, la seule chose que je voudrais connaître, ce serait Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme celui qui a été crucifié.
fr.R: Quand j’étais avec vous, j’ai décidé de ne penser et de ne parler que de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, et de la manière dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est mort sur la croix.

sw.L: Kwa maana niliamua kutojua kitu chochote kati yenu isipokuwa Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyesulubiwa.
sw.B: Niliamua hivi: nilipokuwa kati yenu, nisijue kitu kingine chochote ila Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kama yule aliyesulubiwa.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi, niliamua kwamba jambo pekee nitakalofikiri na kulizungumzia ni Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na jinsi alivyokufa msalabani.

es.L: Porque decidí no saber nada entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sino a {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} y a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} crucificado.
es.B: Tomé esta decisión: mientras estuviera entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, no sabría de ninguna otra cosa sino de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} y de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} como el crucificado.
es.R: Mientras estuve con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, decidí pensar y hablar solamente de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} y de cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} murió en la cruz.

vi.L: Vì tôi đã quyết định không biết điều gì giữa anh chị em ngoại trừ Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, và [Ngài] là Đấng đã bị đóng đinh trên thập tự giá.
vi.B: Tôi đã quyết định thế này: khi ở giữa anh chị em, điều duy nhất tôi biết là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng đã chịu đóng đinh trên thập tự giá.
vi.R: Khi ở với anh chị em, tôi đã quyết định rằng điều duy nhất tôi suy nghĩ và nói đến là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, và việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chết trên thập tự giá.

ko.L: 나는 여러분 가운데 있는 동안 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, 곧 십자가에 못 박히신 그분 외에는 아무것도 알지 않기로 작정했기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 나는 여러분과 함께 있는 동안, 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, 그것도 십자가에 못 박히신 그분 말고는 아무것도 알지 않기로 마음먹었습니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분과 함께 있을 때, 오직 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 대해서만 생각하고 말하기로 했습니다. 그분이 십자가에서 죽으신 일에 대해서만 말하기로 했습니다.

decisions.choice: a firm decision to know nothing else
alternatives: I did not think it right to know anything
decisions.reason: The negative οὐ stands before the verb ἔκρινά but belongs in sense with what follows: Paul made up his mind that he would know nothing but Christ. γὰρ ("for") gives the reason for verse 1: he came without display because this was his whole message.

decisions.choice: to know: to have as the whole subject of his attention and his preaching
decisions.reason: Paul is not claiming ignorance of other things. "Know" here means what he gave himself to and spoke about while among them.

decisions.choice: and him as the crucified one: Christ precisely in his death on the cross
decisions.reason: τοῦτον ἐσταυρωμένον ("and this one, crucified") singles out the cross. The perfect participle presents Jesus as the one who was crucified and remains the crucified one, even as the risen Lord. Crucifixion was the most shameful of deaths, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles (1:23), yet it was the center of Paul's message.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: My decision was this: ...
decisions.reason: Balanced states the decision first and then its content, so the emphasis on "the only thing" is clear.

decisions.choice: think and talk about; how he died on the cross
decisions.reason: Readable says what "know" means here (m2) and spells out "crucified" for young readers.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns (yeye)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun, as in English
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1: Swahili marks most pronouns for God and Christ inside the verb ("alivyokufa", "wanaompenda" in verse 9), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives.

decisions.choice: "và [Ngài] là Đấng đã bị đóng đinh" (L) for "and him crucified"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese cannot hang a participle on a pronoun as the Greek does, so Literal supplies "Ngài là Đấng"; the bracketed pronoun stands where the English "him" has the setting, and the capital is kept, as a pronoun for Christ always has it.

source.text: κἀγὼ ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ καὶ ἐν φόβῳ καὶ ἐν τρόμῳ πολλῷ ἐγενόμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ ὁ λόγος μου καὶ τὸ κήρυγμά μου οὐκ ἐν πειθοῖ σοφίας ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀποδείξει πνεύματος καὶ δυνάμεως, ἵνα ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν μὴ ᾖ ἐν σοφίᾳ ἀνθρώπων ἀλλ’ ἐν δυνάμει θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And I in weakness and in fear and in trembling much came to be with you, \v 4 and the word of me and the proclamation of me [were] not in persuasion of wisdom but in demonstration of Spirit and of power, \v 5 so that the faith of you not may be in wisdom of men but in power of God.

en.L: And I was with you in weakness and in fear and in much trembling, \v 4 and my word and my proclamation [were] not in [the] persuasion of wisdom but in [the] demonstration of [the] Spirit and of power, \v 5 so that your faith might not be in [the] wisdom of {{gender:people|men}} but in [the] power of God.
en.B: While I was with you, I was weak and afraid, and I trembled greatly. \v 4 My message and my preaching did not depend on wisdom's power to persuade; they were proof given by the Spirit and by power, \v 5 so that your faith would be grounded not in human wisdom but in the power of God.
en.R: When I was with you, I felt weak. I was afraid, and I was shaking all over. \v 4 When I spoke and preached to you, I did not try to win you over with clever arguments. Instead, God's Spirit worked with power, and that proved my message was true. \v 5 This was so that your faith would not depend on human wisdom. It would depend on the power of God.

fr.L: Et moi, j’ai été auprès de vous dans la faiblesse, et dans la crainte, et dans un grand tremblement, \v 4 et ma parole et ma prédication [n’étaient] pas dans la persuasion de la sagesse, mais dans la démonstration de l’Esprit et de la puissance, \v 5 afin que votre foi ne soit pas dans la sagesse {{gender:des humains|des hommes}}, mais dans la puissance de Dieu.
fr.B: Pendant que j’étais avec vous, j’étais faible et craintif, et je tremblais beaucoup. \v 4 Mon message et ma prédication ne reposaient pas sur le pouvoir de persuasion de la sagesse ; ils étaient une preuve donnée par l’Esprit et par la puissance, \v 5 pour que votre foi soit fondée non sur la sagesse humaine, mais sur la puissance de Dieu.
fr.R: Quand j’étais avec vous, je me sentais faible. J’avais peur, et je tremblais de tout mon corps. \v 4 Quand je vous ai parlé et que je vous ai annoncé le message, je n’ai pas essayé de vous convaincre avec des arguments habiles. Au contraire, l’Esprit de Dieu a agi avec puissance, et cela a prouvé que mon message était vrai. \v 5 C’était pour que votre foi ne dépende pas de la sagesse humaine, mais de la puissance de Dieu.

sw.L: Nami nilikaa pamoja nanyi nikiwa katika udhaifu, na katika hofu, na katika kutetemeka sana, \v 4 na neno langu na mahubiri yangu [hayakuwa] katika ushawishi wa hekima, bali katika udhihirisho wa Roho na wa nguvu, \v 5 ili imani yenu isisimame katika hekima ya wanadamu, bali katika nguvu ya Mungu.
sw.B: Nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi, nilikuwa dhaifu na mwenye hofu, na nilitetemeka sana. \v 4 Ujumbe wangu na mahubiri yangu havikutegemea uwezo wa hekima wa kushawishi; vilikuwa uthibitisho uliotolewa na Roho na kwa nguvu, \v 5 ili imani yenu ijengwe si juu ya hekima ya kibinadamu, bali juu ya nguvu ya Mungu.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi, nilijisikia dhaifu. Niliogopa, na mwili wangu wote ulikuwa ukitetemeka. \v 4 Nilipozungumza na kuhubiri kwenu, sikujaribu kuwashawishi kwa hoja za ujanja. Badala yake, Roho wa Mungu alifanya kazi kwa nguvu, na hilo lilithibitisha kwamba ujumbe wangu ni wa kweli. \v 5 Hii ilikuwa ili imani yenu isitegemee hekima ya kibinadamu, bali itegemee nguvu ya Mungu.

es.L: Y yo estuve con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en debilidad, y en temor, y en mucho temblor, \v 4 y mi palabra y mi predicación [no fueron] con persuasión de sabiduría, sino con demostración del Espíritu y de poder, \v 5 para que {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe no estuviera en sabiduría de {{gender:seres humanos|hombres}}, sino en poder de Dios.
es.B: Mientras estuve con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, me sentía débil y con miedo, y temblaba mucho. \v 4 Mi mensaje y mi predicación no se apoyaron en el poder de persuasión de la sabiduría; fueron una demostración dada por el Espíritu y por el poder, \v 5 para que {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe no se basara en la sabiduría humana, sino en el poder de Dios.
es.R: Cuando estuve con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, me sentía débil. Tenía miedo y temblaba de pies a cabeza. \v 4 Cuando {{plural_you:les|os}} hablaba y predicaba, no traté de {{plural_you:convencerlos|convenceros}} con argumentos ingeniosos. En cambio, el Espíritu de Dios actuó con poder, y eso demostró que mi mensaje era verdadero. \v 5 Así {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe no dependería de la sabiduría humana. Dependería del poder de Dios.

vi.L: Và tôi đã ở với anh chị em trong sự yếu đuối, trong sự sợ hãi và trong nhiều run rẩy, \v 4 và lời nói của tôi cùng sự rao giảng của tôi [đã] không ở trong sự thuyết phục của sự khôn ngoan, nhưng trong sự chứng tỏ của Thánh Linh và của quyền năng, \v 5 để đức tin của anh chị em không ở trong sự khôn ngoan của loài người, nhưng trong quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Khi ở với anh chị em, tôi yếu đuối, sợ hãi và run rẩy rất nhiều. \v 4 Lời giảng và sứ điệp của tôi không dựa vào sức thuyết phục của sự khôn ngoan, nhưng là bằng chứng do Thánh Linh và quyền năng ban cho, \v 5 để đức tin của anh chị em không đặt nền trên sự khôn ngoan của loài người, nhưng trên quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Khi ở với anh chị em, tôi cảm thấy mình yếu đuối. Tôi sợ hãi, và người tôi run lên. \v 4 Khi nói chuyện và rao giảng cho anh chị em, tôi không tìm cách thuyết phục anh chị em bằng những lý lẽ khéo léo. Thay vào đó, Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời đã hành động với quyền năng, và điều đó chứng tỏ sứ điệp của tôi là thật. \v 5 Như vậy, đức tin của anh chị em không dựa vào sự khôn ngoan của loài người, mà dựa vào quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 약함과 두려움과 많은 떨림 가운데 여러분과 함께 있었습니다. \v 4 내 말과 내 전도는 지혜의 설득으로 [된 것이] 아니라 성령과 능력의 증명으로 [된 것]이었습니다. \v 5 이는 여러분의 믿음이 사람들의 지혜에 있지 않고 하나님의 능력에 있게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 내가 여러분과 함께 있을 때 나는 약했고, 두려워했고, 몹시 떨었습니다. \v 4 내 말과 내 설교는 지혜의 설득하는 힘에 기대지 않았습니다. 그것은 성령과 능력으로 주어진 증명이었습니다. \v 5 그것은 여러분의 믿음이 사람의 지혜에 바탕을 두지 않고 하나님의 능력에 바탕을 두게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분과 함께 있을 때 약하다고 느꼈습니다. 두려웠고, 온몸이 떨렸습니다. \v 4 내가 여러분에게 말하고 전할 때, 나는 똑똑한 말로 여러분을 설득하려고 하지 않았습니다. 그 대신 하나님의 성령께서 능력으로 일하셨고, 그것이 내가 전한 말이 참되다는 것을 보여 주었습니다. \v 5 그래서 여러분의 믿음은 사람의 지혜에 기대지 않고 하나님의 능력에 기대게 되었습니다.

decisions.choice: weakness: Paul's frailty and unimpressive presence, which may have included illness
decisions.reason: ἀσθενείᾳ can mean bodily sickness or weakness in general. Paul's critics said his bodily presence was weak and his speech of no account (2 Corinthians 10:10), and he once preached in Galatia because of an illness (Galatians 4:13). Here the word describes how he came across, in contrast to the confident display of skilled speakers.

decisions.choice: fear and trembling: deep seriousness and anxiety before a weighty task, not mere stage fright
decisions.reason: The pair is common in the Greek Old Testament (Exodus 15:16; Isaiah 19:16), and Paul uses it for earnest, humble seriousness (2 Corinthians 7:15; Philippians 2:12). In Corinth he also had real reason to be afraid: Acts 18:9-10 tells how the Lord told him in a vision not to be afraid there.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "persuasion of wisdom"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ a great deal here. Most add "words" (as in verse 13), and many also "human". The SBLGNT prints the short reading πειθοῖ σοφίας, found in a few early witnesses, in which πειθοῖ is read as the noun "persuasion"; the adjective that the longer readings use is otherwise unknown in Greek. All the readings say that Paul's preaching did not rely on persuasive skill. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a demonstration given by the Spirit, working with power
alternatives: a demonstration of Paul's own spirit and strength
decisions.reason: ἀποδείξει was a word of the speakers' schools for a compelling proof that settles an argument. Paul says the proof of his message was not argument but the Spirit at work: people turned to God, and signs and wonders went with his preaching (Romans 15:19; 2 Corinthians 12:12; 1 Thessalonians 1:5). "Spirit and power" go together: the Spirit's powerful working.

decisions.choice: my word and my proclamation: what Paul said and the way he announced it, his whole preaching
decisions.reason: λόγος is the message or speech; κήρυγμά is a herald's announcement, used in 1:21 for the preaching God uses to save. Together they cover all his preaching in Corinth.

decisions.choice: so that: the purpose behind the way the gospel came to them
decisions.reason: ἵνα gives the purpose: faith that rests on God's power cannot be shaken as faith won by clever argument could be. "Faith in" here means faith that has its ground in God's power, not faith whose object is power. The purpose is Paul's, and behind it God's (1:27-29).

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπων means human beings in general. Literal keeps the noun with the traditional form as the alternative; Balanced and Readable say "human", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: proof given by the Spirit and by power
alternatives: demonstration of the Spirit and of power
decisions.reason: "Demonstration" in English suggests a display or a protest march; "proof" keeps the sense of the speakers' term (m4).

decisions.choice: God's Spirit worked with power, and that proved my message was true
alternatives: in demonstration of the Spirit and of power
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the proof was and what it proved (m4).

decisions.choice: {{gender:des humains|des hommes}} (L); la sagesse humaine (B, R) (for the whole book: the setting on the noun for a human being)
decisions.reason: As in English, the word means human beings in general. French puts the setting on the noun only; pronouns that refer back to it ("lui", "il", 2:11, 2:14) are ordinary generic French and take no span, as the style guide says. Balanced and Readable say "humaine", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:seres humanos|hombres}}
decisions.reason: Spanish follows the English setting: the Greek word means human beings of either sex, so "seres humanos" is the default and "hombres" the traditional alternative, as in Romans 1:18.

decisions.choice: wanadamu, no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wanadamu" (human beings) is already inclusive, so Swahili has no counterpart to the English Literal span; a "traditional" alternative would mean males only and change the meaning.

decisions.choice: "loài người" (L, B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "loài người" already means humankind, men and women, so the gender setting the English Literal has here is not needed, as in Romans 1:18.

decisions.choice: "성령과 능력의 증명" (L); "성령과 능력으로 주어진 증명" (B); "성령께서 능력으로 일하셨고" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as a proof that settles an argument, given by the Spirit; "증명" is that word in Korean. The Spirit is "성령" with the honorific (께서) through the letter.

source.text: Σοφίαν δὲ λαλοῦμεν ἐν τοῖς τελείοις, σοφίαν δὲ οὐ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου οὐδὲ τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου τῶν καταργουμένων·

records.literal_gloss: Wisdom however we speak among the mature, wisdom however not of the age this nor of the rulers of the age this, the [ones] being brought to nothing;

en.L: Yet we do speak wisdom among the mature, but a wisdom not of this age nor of the rulers of this age, who are being brought to nothing.
en.B: There is a wisdom we speak, all the same, among those who are mature. It is not the wisdom of this present age, nor of its rulers, whose power is already being brought to an end.
en.R: But we do teach wisdom to people who are grown up in their faith. It is not the kind of wisdom people value in this present age. It is not the wisdom of the rulers of this age either, and their power is already coming to an end.

fr.L: Pourtant, nous parlons d’une sagesse parmi ceux qui sont mûrs, mais d’une sagesse qui n’est pas de cet âge ni des dirigeants de cet âge, qui sont en train d’être réduits à néant.
fr.B: Il y a pourtant une sagesse dont nous parlons parmi ceux qui sont mûrs. Ce n’est pas la sagesse de l’âge présent, ni celle de ses dirigeants, dont le pouvoir est déjà en train de prendre fin.
fr.R: Mais nous enseignons bien une sagesse aux gens qui ont grandi dans leur foi. Ce n’est pas le genre de sagesse que les gens admirent à l’époque présente. Ce n’est pas non plus la sagesse des dirigeants de cette époque, et leur pouvoir est déjà en train de finir.

sw.L: Lakini tunanena hekima kati ya waliokomaa, lakini hekima isiyo ya zama hizi, wala ya watawala wa zama hizi, wanaobatilishwa.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, kuna hekima tunayoinena kati ya wale waliokomaa. Si hekima ya zama hizi za sasa, wala ya watawala wake, ambao mamlaka yao tayari yanakomeshwa.
sw.R: Lakini tunawafundisha hekima watu waliokomaa katika imani yao. Si hekima ambayo watu wa zama hizi za sasa wanaithamini. Wala si hekima ya watawala wa zama hizi, na mamlaka yao tayari yanafikia mwisho.

es.L: Sin embargo, hablamos sabiduría entre los maduros, pero una sabiduría no de esta era ni de los gobernantes de esta era, que están siendo reducidos a nada.
es.B: Con todo, hay una sabiduría que enseñamos entre los que son maduros. No es la sabiduría de esta era presente ni de sus gobernantes, cuyo poder ya está siendo anulado.
es.R: Pero sí enseñamos sabiduría a los que han crecido en su fe. No es la clase de sabiduría que la gente valora en esta era presente. Tampoco es la sabiduría de los gobernantes de esta era, y su poder ya se está acabando.

vi.L: Tuy nhiên, chúng tôi có nói sự khôn ngoan giữa những người trưởng thành, nhưng không phải sự khôn ngoan của đời này, cũng không phải của các nhà cầm quyền của đời này, là những kẻ đang bị làm cho tiêu mất.
vi.B: Dầu vậy, vẫn có một sự khôn ngoan mà chúng tôi nói ra giữa những người trưởng thành. Đó không phải là sự khôn ngoan của thời đại hiện nay, cũng không phải của các nhà cầm quyền thời đại này, là những người mà quyền lực đang bị chấm dứt.
vi.R: Nhưng chúng tôi có dạy sự khôn ngoan cho những người đã trưởng thành trong đức tin. Đó không phải là loại khôn ngoan mà người ta coi trọng trong thời đại hiện nay. Đó cũng không phải là sự khôn ngoan của những nhà cầm quyền trong thời đại này, và quyền lực của họ đang đi đến chỗ chấm dứt.

ko.L: 그러나 우리는 성숙한 사람들 가운데서 지혜를 말합니다. 그러나 이 세대의 지혜도 아니고, 없어져 가고 있는 이 세대의 통치자들의 [지혜]도 아닙니다.
ko.B: 그렇지만 우리도 성숙한 사람들 가운데서는 지혜를 말합니다. 그러나 그것은 이 시대의 지혜도 아니고, 이미 힘을 잃어 가고 있는 이 시대 통치자들의 지혜도 아닙니다.
ko.R: 그러나 우리도 믿음이 다 자란 사람들에게는 지혜를 가르칩니다. 그것은 지금 이 세상 사람들이 귀하게 여기는 지혜가 아닙니다. 이 세상 통치자들의 지혜도 아닙니다. 그들의 힘은 벌써 끝나 가고 있습니다.

decisions.choice: yet we do speak wisdom: after rejecting the world's wisdom, Paul says the gospel has a wisdom of its own
decisions.reason: Σοφίαν stands first for emphasis, and δὲ marks a turn. Having refused to preach with clever wisdom (1:17-2:5), Paul now says the message of the cross is itself God's wisdom (1:24, 1:30). "We" is Paul and those who preach with him (3:5-9).

decisions.choice: the mature: believers who have grown up in faith
alternatives: the initiated, as in the mystery religions
an inner circle of advanced believers
decisions.reason: τελείοις means full-grown, complete. In 3:1-2 and 14:20 Paul sets it against being infants. He is not describing a separate elite with secret teaching: he expects all the Corinthians to become mature, and blames them for staying infants (3:1-3). He may be taking up a word some in Corinth used of themselves, as he seems to in Philippians 3:15.

decisions.choice: this age: the present world-order, which is passing away
decisions.reason: Jewish thought spoke of "this age" and "the age to come". "This age" is the world as it now is, with its values and powers, which God has begun to replace (1:20; Galatians 1:4).

decisions.choice: the rulers of this age: the human authorities who crucified Jesus, and possibly the spiritual powers behind them
decisions.reason: Verse 8 says these rulers crucified the Lord of glory, which points to the authorities in Jerusalem and Rome: the chief priests, Herod and Pilate (Acts 4:26-28; 13:27). Paul uses the same word for human rulers in Romans 13:3. Some read it as the evil spiritual powers (compare Ephesians 6:12; Colossians 2:15), and Paul may see the two together. The text does not settle this.

decisions.choice: being brought to nothing: their power is already being undone, and God is the one undoing it
alternatives: they will be brought to nothing in the future
decisions.reason: The participle καταργουμένων is present and passive: the process is under way now. In 1:28 Paul uses the same verb of God, who chose what is nothing to bring to nothing what is something.

decisions.choice: being brought to an end (B); coming to an end (R)
decisions.reason: Both levels keep the present process (m5). "Their power" is supplied so that it is clear the rulers' rule is ending.

decisions.choice: people who are grown up in their faith
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of maturity is meant (m2). "Perfect" would suggest people without fault.

decisions.choice: ceux qui sont mûrs (L, B); les gens qui ont grandi dans leur foi (R)
decisions.reason: "Les parfaits" would suggest people without fault, or a spiritual elite, which the meaning decision rules out (m2). "Ceux qui sont mûrs" also needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: les dirigeants de cet âge
decisions.reason: "Princes" today means royal sons. "Dirigeants" covers the human authorities who crucified Jesus and leaves room for the powers behind them (m4); "chefs" was used in Colossians for the unseen powers paired with authorities.

decisions.choice: los maduros (L); los que son maduros (B); los que han crecido en su fe (R)
decisions.reason: The word means grown up, mature in faith (m2), not a spiritual elite. Spanish "perfectos", an older rendering, would suggest people without fault, so every level speaks of maturity.

decisions.choice: watawala
decisions.reason: Elsewhere this Greek word is "kiongozi" (leader). Here the rulers of this age are those with power who crucified Jesus, and perhaps the powers behind them (meaning decision), so "watawala" (those who rule) is used, here and in verse 8.

decisions.choice: waliokomaa
decisions.reason: "Wakamilifu" (perfect, complete) would suggest people without fault or a spiritual elite; the meaning decision describes believers who have grown up, which "waliokomaa" (matured, grown up) says. Readable adds "katika imani yao", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "những người trưởng thành" (L, B); "những người đã trưởng thành trong đức tin" (R) for teleioi
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 3:15: the word means grown-up believers, not a spiritual elite or people without fault.

decisions.choice: "các nhà cầm quyền của đời này" for the rulers of this age (also 2:8)
decisions.reason: "Nhà cầm quyền" names human authorities, which they at least are (m4); "bậc cai trị" is kept in Colossians for the unseen powers, and would settle the question the other way.

decisions.choice: "성숙한 사람들" (L, B); "믿음이 다 자란 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as full-grown believers, set against infants in 3:1, not a spiritual elite; "성숙한" says this, where "완전한" would suggest people without fault.

source.text: ἀλλὰ λαλοῦμεν θεοῦ σοφίαν ἐν μυστηρίῳ, τὴν ἀποκεκρυμμένην, ἣν προώρισεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς δόξαν ἡμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: but we speak of God wisdom in mystery, the [wisdom] having been hidden, which foreordained the God before the ages for glory of us;

en.L: but we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the [wisdom] that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the ages for our glory.
en.B: Instead, the wisdom we speak is God's own, a mystery that has been kept hidden. God planned it before the ages for our glory.
en.R: We speak about God's wisdom, which used to be a secret. God kept it hidden. But long before the world began, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planned it so that we would share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

fr.L: mais nous parlons de la sagesse de Dieu en mystère, [la sagesse] qui a été cachée, que Dieu a déterminée d’avance avant les âges pour notre gloire.
fr.B: Au contraire, la sagesse dont nous parlons est celle de Dieu, un mystère qui a été tenu caché. Dieu l’a prévue avant les âges pour notre gloire.
fr.R: Nous parlons de la sagesse de Dieu, qui était autrefois un secret. Dieu l’a tenue cachée. Mais bien avant la création du monde, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait prévue pour que nous ayons part à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

sw.L: bali tunanena hekima ya Mungu katika siri, [hekima] iliyofichwa, ambayo Mungu aliikusudia kabla ya nyakati kwa ajili ya utukufu wetu.
sw.B: Badala yake, hekima tunayoinena ni ya Mungu mwenyewe, siri ambayo imekuwa imefichwa. Mungu aliipanga kabla ya nyakati kwa ajili ya utukufu wetu.
sw.R: Tunazungumza kuhusu hekima ya Mungu, ambayo zamani ilikuwa siri. Mungu aliificha. Lakini muda mrefu kabla ulimwengu haujaanza, aliipanga ili tushiriki utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

es.L: sino que hablamos sabiduría de Dios en misterio, la que ha estado escondida, que Dios predestinó antes de los siglos para nuestra gloria.
es.B: Más bien, la sabiduría que enseñamos es la de Dios mismo, un misterio que ha estado escondido. Dios la planeó antes de los siglos para nuestra gloria.
es.R: Hablamos de la sabiduría de Dios, que antes era un misterio, un plan secreto. Dios la mantuvo escondida. Pero mucho antes de que el mundo comenzara, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la planeó para que nosotros tuviéramos parte en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

vi.L: nhưng chúng tôi nói sự khôn ngoan của Đức Chúa Trời trong sự mầu nhiệm, [sự khôn ngoan] đã được giấu kín, mà Đức Chúa Trời đã định trước từ trước các đời để đem vinh quang cho chúng ta.
vi.B: Trái lại, sự khôn ngoan chúng tôi nói ra là của chính Đức Chúa Trời, là một sự mầu nhiệm đã được giấu kín. Đức Chúa Trời đã định sẵn sự khôn ngoan ấy từ trước các đời để chúng ta được vinh quang.
vi.R: Chúng tôi nói về sự khôn ngoan của Đức Chúa Trời, là điều trước kia vẫn còn là bí mật. Đức Chúa Trời đã giấu kín điều đó. Nhưng từ lâu trước khi tạo dựng thế gian, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hoạch định điều ấy để chúng ta được dự phần vào vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 오히려 우리는 비밀 가운데 있는 하나님의 지혜, 곧 감추어져 있던 [지혜]를 말합니다. 그것은 하나님께서 세대들 전에 우리의 영광을 위하여 미리 정하신 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 말하는 지혜는 하나님의 지혜, 곧 감추어져 있던 비밀입니다. 하나님께서는 세상이 시작되기 전에 우리에게 영광을 주시려고 그 지혜를 미리 정해 두셨습니다.
ko.R: 우리가 말하는 것은 하나님의 지혜입니다. 그것은 전에는 비밀이었습니다. 하나님께서 그것을 감추어 두셨습니다. 그러나 하나님께서는 세상이 시작되기 오래전에, 우리가 그분의 영광을 함께 누리도록 그것을 계획해 두셨습니다.

decisions.choice: God's wisdom: the word God stands first, in contrast to the wisdom of this age
decisions.reason: θεοῦ comes before σοφίαν for emphasis: the wisdom Paul speaks is not the wisdom "of this age" (verse 6) but God's.

decisions.choice: a mystery: God's wisdom was hidden in the past and is now made known
alternatives: Paul speaks in a secretive way, as to initiates
decisions.reason: For Paul a mystery is not a riddle kept from outsiders but God's plan, hidden through past ages and now revealed (Romans 16:25-26; Colossians 1:26). The phrase describes the wisdom, not a hidden manner of speaking, for verse 10 says God has revealed it.

decisions.choice: planned beforehand, before the ages
decisions.reason: προώρισεν means to decide or mark out in advance. πρὸ τῶν αἰώνων ("before the ages") places God's plan before time and history began. The cross was not an accident or a defeat but the wisdom God had planned.

decisions.choice: for our glory: the share in God's glory that believers are to have
alternatives: for our honor or fame now
decisions.reason: Glory here is the splendor of God's presence that believers will share when Christ comes (Romans 8:18, 8:30; 2 Corinthians 4:17). It contrasts with the rulers whose power is passing (verse 6), and points to "the Lord of glory" in verse 8.

decisions.choice: mystery (L, B); secret (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:26-27: "mystery" is the term Paul uses, and Readable says "secret", since "mystery" can suggest something that can never be understood.

decisions.choice: used to be a secret; share in his glory
alternatives: that has been hidden; for our glory
decisions.reason: Readable says that the secret is now told (m2) and what "our glory" means (m4).

decisions.choice: mystère (L, B); secret (R) (for the whole book)
alternatives: mystère at every level, as in Colossians
decisions.reason: The Corinthians term sheet has Readable say "secret", as the English does, since "mystère" can suggest something that can never be understood; Readable says that the secret is now told (m2).

decisions.choice: un misterio, un plan secreto
decisions.reason: As in Colossians, "misterio" is kept at every level; where the English Readable says "secret", the Spanish Readable keeps "misterio" and explains it as a secret plan, now made known (m2).

decisions.choice: antes de los siglos
decisions.reason: "Before the ages" is said in Spanish as "antes de los siglos", a set phrase for "before time began"; "antes de las eras" is not used. Elsewhere "this age" stays "esta era".

decisions.choice: siri
decisions.reason: "Siri" (secret, mystery) is the word Swahili Colossians uses for this Greek word, and it serves every level: a secret once hidden and now made known. "Fumbo" is a riddle.

decisions.choice: "sự mầu nhiệm" (L, B); "điều ... bí mật" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians and Romans 11:25: Readable says "a secret", and adds that it is now made known.

decisions.choice: "비밀" at every level, Readable adding "전에는 비밀이었습니다"
decisions.reason: "비밀" is the word of Romans 16:25 and Colossians 1:26 for God's plan once hidden and now made known; "신비" suggests something that cannot be understood.

source.text: ἣν οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἔγνωκεν, εἰ γὰρ ἔγνωσαν, οὐκ ἂν τὸν κύριον τῆς δόξης ἐσταύρωσαν·

records.literal_gloss: which none of the rulers of the age this has known, for if they had known, not [would] the Lord of the glory they have crucified;

en.L: which none of the rulers of this age has understood; for if they had understood [it], they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
en.B: Not one of this age's rulers grasped this wisdom. Had they grasped it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
en.R: None of the rulers of this present age understood God's wisdom. If they had, they would not have killed the glorious Lord on a cross.

fr.L: laquelle aucun des dirigeants de cet âge n’a connue, car s’ils [l’]avaient connue, ils n’auraient pas crucifié le Seigneur de la gloire.
fr.B: Aucun des dirigeants de l’âge présent n’a compris cette sagesse. S’ils l’avaient comprise, ils n’auraient pas crucifié le Seigneur de gloire.
fr.R: Aucun des dirigeants de l’époque présente n’a compris la sagesse de Dieu. S’ils l’avaient comprise, ils n’auraient pas tué le Seigneur glorieux sur une croix.

sw.L: ambayo hakuna hata mmoja wa watawala wa zama hizi aliyeielewa; kwa maana kama wangeielewa, wasingemsulubisha Bwana wa utukufu.
sw.B: Hakuna hata mmoja wa watawala wa zama hizi aliyeifahamu hekima hii. Kama wangeifahamu, wasingemsulubisha Bwana wa utukufu.
sw.R: Hakuna hata mmoja wa watawala wa zama hizi za sasa aliyeielewa hekima ya Mungu. Kama wangeielewa, wasingemuua Bwana mwenye utukufu msalabani.

es.L: la cual ninguno de los gobernantes de esta era ha conocido; porque si [la] hubieran conocido, no habrían crucificado al Señor de la gloria.
es.B: Ninguno de los gobernantes de esta era comprendió esta sabiduría. Si la hubieran comprendido, no habrían crucificado al Señor de la gloria.
es.R: Ninguno de los gobernantes de esta era presente entendió la sabiduría de Dios. Si la hubieran entendido, no habrían matado en una cruz al Señor glorioso.

vi.L: là điều không một ai trong các nhà cầm quyền của đời này đã hiểu biết, vì nếu họ đã hiểu biết, thì họ đã không đóng đinh Chúa vinh quang trên thập tự giá.
vi.B: Không một nhà cầm quyền nào của thời đại này hiểu được sự khôn ngoan ấy. Nếu hiểu được, họ đã không đóng đinh Chúa vinh quang trên thập tự giá.
vi.R: Không ai trong những nhà cầm quyền của thời đại hiện nay hiểu được sự khôn ngoan của Đức Chúa Trời. Nếu hiểu được, họ đã không giết Chúa vinh hiển trên thập tự giá.

ko.L: 이 세대의 통치자들 가운데 아무도 그것을 알지 못했습니다. 만일 알았더라면 그들이 영광의 주님을 십자가에 못 박지 않았을 것입니다.
ko.B: 이 시대의 통치자들 가운데 아무도 이 지혜를 깨닫지 못했습니다. 깨달았더라면 그들이 영광의 주님을 십자가에 못 박지 않았을 것입니다.
ko.R: 지금 이 세상을 다스리는 사람들 가운데 아무도 하나님의 지혜를 깨닫지 못했습니다. 깨달았다면 그들은 영광스러운 주님을 십자가에 못 박아 죽이지 않았을 것입니다.

decisions.choice: which: God's wisdom (verse 7)
decisions.reason: ἣν picks up the wisdom of verse 7, as the relative in that verse did. The rulers failed to understand God's plan.

decisions.choice: an unreal condition: they did not understand, and so they crucified him
decisions.reason: εἰ with the past tense and ἂν states something contrary to fact. Their crucifying Jesus shows that they did not understand; in their ignorance they carried out the very plan God had made (Acts 3:17-18).

decisions.choice: the Lord of glory: the Lord to whom glory belongs, a title used of God
alternatives: a glorious lord, as an earthly ruler might be called
decisions.reason: In the Psalms God is "the King of glory" (Psalm 24:7-10) and "the God of glory" (Psalm 29:3; compare Acts 7:2). Paul gives this kind of title to the crucified Jesus (compare James 2:1). The one put to the most shameful of deaths is the Lord who has God's glory.

decisions.choice: killed on a cross
decisions.reason: Readable says what crucifying meant, as in verse 2.

decisions.choice: the glorious Lord
decisions.reason: Readable turns the Hebrew-style phrase into a plain adjective; the key term is kept (m3).

source.text: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται· Ἃ ὀφθαλμὸς οὐκ εἶδεν καὶ οὖς οὐκ ἤκουσεν καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἀνέβη, ὅσα ἡτοίμασεν ὁ θεὸς τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: but just as it has been written: What eye not saw and ear not heard and upon heart of man not came up, as many as prepared the God for those loving him.

en.L: But, just as it is written, "Things that eye has not seen and ear has not heard, and [that] have not come up upon [the] heart of {{gender:a human being|man}}, all that God has prepared for those who love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: But this is what Scripture describes: "Things no eye ever saw and no ear ever heard, things that never rose up in any human heart: these God has made ready for those who love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: But this is what the Scriptures say: "Nobody has ever seen it or heard of it. Nobody has ever even dreamed of it. That is what God has made ready for the people who love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

fr.L: Mais, comme il est écrit : « Ce que l’œil n’a pas vu, et ce que l’oreille n’a pas entendu, et ce qui n’est pas monté au cœur {{gender:de l’être humain|de l’homme}}, tout ce que Dieu a préparé pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aiment. »
fr.B: Mais voici ce que décrit l’Écriture : « Ce qu’aucun œil n’a jamais vu, ce qu’aucune oreille n’a jamais entendu, ce qui n’est jamais venu à l’esprit d’aucun être humain, voilà ce que Dieu a préparé pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aiment. »
fr.R: Mais voici ce que disent les Écritures : « Personne ne l’a jamais vu, ni n’en a jamais entendu parler. Personne n’en a même jamais rêvé. Voilà ce que Dieu a préparé pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aiment. »

sw.L: Lakini, kama ilivyoandikwa, "Yale ambayo jicho halijayaona, na sikio halijayasikia, na hayajapanda juu ya moyo wa mwanadamu, yote ambayo Mungu amewaandalia wanaompenda."
sw.B: Lakini haya ndiyo yanayoelezwa na Maandiko: "Mambo ambayo hakuna jicho lililowahi kuyaona, wala sikio lililowahi kuyasikia, mambo ambayo hayajawahi kuingia katika fikira za mwanadamu yeyote: hayo ndiyo Mungu amewaandalia wale wanaompenda."
sw.R: Lakini Maandiko yanasema hivi: "Hakuna mtu aliyewahi kuyaona wala kuyasikia. Hakuna aliyewahi hata kuyawazia. Hayo ndiyo mambo ambayo Mungu amewaandalia watu wanaompenda."

es.L: Pero, así como está escrito: «Lo que ojo no vio y oído no oyó, y [lo que] no subió al corazón del {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}, cuanto Dios ha preparado para los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} aman».
es.B: Pero esto es lo que describe la Escritura: «Lo que ningún ojo vio jamás y ningún oído oyó, lo que nunca surgió en ningún corazón humano: eso ha preparado Dios para los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} aman».
es.R: Pero esto es lo que dicen las Escrituras: «Nadie lo ha visto nunca ni ha oído hablar de ello. Nadie se lo ha imaginado siquiera. Eso es lo que Dios ha preparado para los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} aman».

vi.L: Nhưng như có chép: "Những điều mắt chưa thấy và tai chưa nghe, và chưa hề nảy lên trong lòng người, tất cả những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã sắm sẵn cho những người yêu mến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Nhưng đây là điều Kinh Thánh mô tả: "Những điều chưa mắt nào từng thấy, chưa tai nào từng nghe, những điều chưa hề nảy ra trong lòng một con người nào, đó là những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã sắm sẵn cho những người yêu mến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Nhưng đây là điều Kinh Thánh nói: "Chưa ai từng thấy điều đó hay nghe nói về điều đó. Cũng chưa ai từng mơ tưởng đến điều đó. Đó là những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã chuẩn bị sẵn cho những người yêu mến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 그러나 기록된 것과 같습니다. "눈이 보지 못하고 귀가 듣지 못하고 사람의 마음에 떠오르지도 않은 것들, 하나님께서 그분을 사랑하는 사람들을 위하여 마련하신 모든 것."
ko.B: 그러나 성경은 이렇게 말합니다. "어떤 눈도 본 적이 없고 어떤 귀도 들은 적이 없으며, 어떤 사람의 마음에도 떠오른 적이 없는 것들, 그것을 하나님께서 그분을 사랑하는 사람들을 위하여 마련해 두셨다."
ko.R: 그러나 성경에 이렇게 쓰여 있습니다. "아무도 그것을 본 적이 없고 들은 적도 없다. 아무도 그런 것을 꿈꾸어 본 적조차 없다. 하나님께서는 그분을 사랑하는 사람들을 위해 바로 그것을 마련해 두셨다."

decisions.choice: a quotation drawn mainly from Isaiah 64:4
alternatives: a quotation from a book now lost
decisions.reason: No known text has these exact words. They are closest to Isaiah 64:4 (64:3 in the Hebrew and Greek): "from of old no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen a God besides you, who acts for those who wait for him". "Come up upon the heart" is a phrase of the Greek Old Testament (compare Isaiah 65:17), and Isaiah 52:15 speaks of kings seeing what they had not been told. The early Christian writer Origen thought Paul was quoting a lost book, the Apocalypse of Elijah. Most likely Paul joins and adapts words from Isaiah. Isaiah says "those who wait for him"; Paul says "those who love him", the language of God's covenant people (Deuteronomy 7:9).

decisions.choice: an unfinished sentence: the quotation sets God's gift against the rulers' ignorance, and verse 10 completes the thought
alternatives: the quotation is the object of "we speak" in verse 7
decisions.reason: ἀλλὰ contrasts with verse 8: the rulers did not understand, but, as Scripture says, God has prepared what no one could have known. The relative clauses of the quotation have no main verb; verse 10 supplies the point: God has revealed these things to us. Some take the quotation as the object of "we speak" in verse 7; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: come up upon the heart: occur to someone, be imagined
decisions.reason: In biblical language the heart is where a person thinks and plans. Something that has not "come up upon the heart" has never entered anyone's mind.

decisions.choice: what God has prepared: the whole of God's saving wisdom in Christ, revealed now and complete in the future
decisions.reason: The words are often applied to heaven. In context they describe God's wisdom, hidden before and now revealed through the Spirit (verse 10), so they include what believers already know as well as what is still to come.

decisions.choice: Scripture describes (B); the Scriptures say (R)
decisions.reason: "It is written" is the standard formula for quoting Scripture; Balanced and Readable name Scripture. Literal keeps the formula.

decisions.choice: {{gender:a human being|man}}
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπου means any human being. Balanced says "any human heart" and Readable "nobody", which need no setting.

decisions.choice: three short sentences
alternatives: one long sentence with relative clauses
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the quotation into short sentences and puts the sense of the idioms (m3) in everyday words. It makes a complete sentence of the unfinished quotation (m2).

decisions.choice: hayajapanda juu ya moyo wa mwanadamu
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew-shaped picture of something coming up upon the heart; Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means, never imagined ("hayajawahi kuingia katika fikira", "kuyawazia").

decisions.choice: "lòng người" (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Người" here is any human being, man or woman, so Vietnamese has only one way to say it.

decisions.choice: "사람의 마음에 떠오르다" (L, B); "꿈꾸어 보다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "come up upon the heart" as something that has never entered anyone's mind; the Korean idiom "마음에 떠오르다" keeps the picture of something rising in the heart.

source.text: ἡμῖν γὰρ ἀπεκάλυψεν ὁ θεὸς διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, τὸ γὰρ πνεῦμα πάντα ἐραυνᾷ, καὶ τὰ βάθη τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: To us for revealed the God through the Spirit; the for Spirit all things searches, even the depths of the God.

en.L: For to us God revealed [these things] through the Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, even the depths of God.
en.B: And it is to us that God has made them known, through the Spirit. For nothing is beyond the Spirit's searching, not even the depths of God.
en.R: But God has shown these things to us through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit. The Spirit looks into everything, even the deepest things about God.

fr.L: Car à nous, Dieu [les] a révélées par l’Esprit ; car l’Esprit scrute tout, même les profondeurs de Dieu.
fr.B: Et c’est à nous que Dieu les a fait connaître, par l’Esprit. Car rien n’échappe aux recherches de l’Esprit, pas même les profondeurs de Dieu.
fr.R: Mais Dieu nous a montré ces choses par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit. L’Esprit examine tout, même ce qu’il y a de plus profond en Dieu.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu ametufunulia sisi [mambo hayo] kupitia Roho; kwa maana Roho huchunguza mambo yote, hata vina vya Mungu.
sw.B: Ni sisi ambao Mungu ametujulisha mambo hayo kupitia Roho. Kwa maana hakuna kitu kisichoweza kuchunguzwa na Roho, hata mambo ya ndani kabisa ya Mungu.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu ametuonyesha mambo haya kupitia Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Roho anachunguza kila kitu, hata mambo yaliyo ndani kabisa ya Mungu.

es.L: Porque a nosotros Dios [nos lo] reveló por medio del Espíritu; porque el Espíritu escudriña todas las cosas, aun las profundidades de Dios.
es.B: Y es a nosotros a quienes Dios se lo ha dado a conocer por medio del Espíritu. Pues nada escapa a la búsqueda del Espíritu, ni siquiera las profundidades de Dios.
es.R: Pero Dios nos ha mostrado estas cosas por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu. El Espíritu lo conoce todo a fondo, hasta las cosas más profundas de Dios.

vi.L: Vì Đức Chúa Trời đã bày tỏ [những điều ấy] cho chúng ta qua Thánh Linh; vì Thánh Linh dò xét mọi sự, ngay cả những điều sâu nhiệm của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Và chính cho chúng ta mà Đức Chúa Trời đã bày tỏ những điều ấy qua Thánh Linh. Vì không có điều gì vượt ngoài sự dò xét của Thánh Linh, ngay cả những điều sâu nhiệm của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã cho chúng ta thấy những điều ấy qua Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Thánh Linh nhìn thấu mọi sự, ngay cả những điều sâu kín nhất về Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 하나님께서는 성령을 통하여 [이것을] 우리에게 드러내 보이셨습니다. 성령께서는 모든 것, 하나님의 깊은 것까지도 살피시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그런데 하나님께서는 성령을 통해 그것을 바로 우리에게 알려 주셨습니다. 성령께서는 모든 것을 살피시고, 하나님의 깊은 곳까지도 살피십니다.
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서는 그분의 성령을 통해 이것을 우리에게 보여 주셨습니다. 성령께서는 모든 것을 살피십니다. 하나님에 대한 가장 깊은 것까지도 아십니다.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "for"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "but" instead of γὰρ ("for"). The SBLGNT prints "for", which some early witnesses have. With "for", verse 10 explains how the hidden things of verse 9 are known; with "but", it contrasts us with the rulers of verse 8. The meaning is much the same. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: to us: emphatic, in contrast to the rulers who did not understand
decisions.reason: ἡμῖν stands first. What the rulers of this age did not know (verse 8), God has made known to believers.

decisions.choice: the Spirit: the Spirit of God, the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: Verse 11 calls him "the Spirit of God", and verse 12 "the Spirit who is from God".

decisions.choice: searches: knows thoroughly, down to the depths; not hunting for what he does not know
decisions.reason: ἐραυνᾷ means to search or examine. Said of the Spirit, it means complete knowledge of God, even "the depths": God's hidden purposes, which are beyond human tracing (Romans 11:33).

decisions.choice: it is to us that God has made them known
alternatives: God has revealed them to us
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the emphasis on "to us" (m2).

decisions.choice: his Spirit
decisions.reason: Readable says whose Spirit is meant (m3).

decisions.choice: escudriña (L); nada escapa a la búsqueda (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the Spirit's thorough knowing (m4). "Escudriñar" is to search to the bottom; "examinar" is kept for the courtroom verb of 2:14-15 and 4:3-4. Readable says plainly that the Spirit knows everything to the depths.

decisions.choice: vina
decisions.reason: "Vina" (depths) keeps the Greek picture at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "the things deep inside God".

decisions.choice: "Thánh Linh" for the Spirit of God, capitalised, through the letter
decisions.reason: The style guide's word for the Spirit, as in the Vietnamese Romans and Galatians; "Đức Thánh Linh" where the Greek says "the Holy Spirit". The Spirit takes the deity_pronoun setting and is never "nó".

source.text: τίς γὰρ οἶδεν ἀνθρώπων τὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰ μὴ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τὸ ἐν αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: Who for knows of men the things of the man except the spirit of the man the [one] in him?

en.L: For who among {{gender:human beings|men}} knows the things of a {{gender:person|man}} except the spirit of the {{gender:person|man}} that is in {{gender:that person|him}}?
en.B: After all, what human being knows what is going on inside someone else? Only that person's own spirit within knows it.
en.R: Think about it: no one can know what someone else is thinking. Only that person's own spirit, deep inside, knows it.

fr.L: Car qui, parmi {{gender:les humains|les hommes}}, connaît les choses {{gender:de l’être humain|de l’homme}}, sinon l’esprit {{gender:de l’être humain|de l’homme}} qui est en lui ?
fr.B: Après tout, quel être humain sait ce qui se passe à l’intérieur d’un autre ? Seul l’esprit de cette personne, en elle, le sait.
fr.R: Réfléchissez : personne ne peut savoir ce que pense quelqu’un d’autre. Seul l’esprit de cette personne, tout au fond d’elle, le sait.

sw.L: Kwa maana ni nani kati ya wanadamu anayejua mambo ya mtu isipokuwa roho ya mtu iliyo ndani yake?
sw.B: Baada ya yote, ni mwanadamu gani anayejua yanayoendelea ndani ya mtu mwingine? Ni roho ya mtu huyo mwenyewe iliyo ndani yake tu inayoyajua.
sw.R: Fikirini jambo hili: hakuna mtu anayeweza kujua mtu mwingine anafikiri nini. Ni roho ya mtu huyo mwenyewe tu, ndani kabisa, inayojua.

es.L: Porque ¿quién de entre los {{gender:seres humanos|hombres}} conoce las cosas del {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}, sino el espíritu del {{gender:ser humano|hombre}} que está en él?
es.B: Después de todo, ¿qué ser humano sabe lo que pasa dentro de otra persona? Solo el propio espíritu de esa persona, en su interior, lo sabe.
es.R: {{plural_you:Piénsenlo|Pensadlo}}: nadie puede saber lo que otra persona está pensando. Solo el propio espíritu de esa persona, en lo más profundo, lo sabe.

vi.L: Vì trong loài người, ai biết những điều của một người, ngoại trừ tâm linh của người ấy ở trong người ấy?
vi.B: Thật vậy, có con người nào biết được những gì đang diễn ra bên trong một người khác? Chỉ có tâm linh của chính người ấy ở bên trong mới biết.
vi.R: Hãy nghĩ xem: không ai có thể biết người khác đang nghĩ gì. Chỉ có tâm linh của chính người đó, ở sâu bên trong họ, mới biết điều ấy.

ko.L: 사람들 가운데 누가 사람의 일을 압니까? 그 사람 속에 있는 그 사람의 영 말고는 [아무도 모릅니다].
ko.B: 사람의 속마음을 누가 알 수 있습니까? 그 사람 속에 있는 그 사람 자신의 영만이 압니다.
ko.R: 생각해 보십시오. 아무도 다른 사람이 무슨 생각을 하는지 알 수 없습니다. 그 사람 속 깊은 곳에 있는 그 사람 자신의 영만이 그것을 압니다.

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer "no one"
decisions.reason: τίς γὰρ ("for who") opens a question that states a fact everyone knows, as an illustration for what follows.

decisions.choice: the things of a person: their inner thoughts, plans and purposes
decisions.reason: The neuter article with a genitive means "what belongs to" someone: here what is in a person's mind, which no one else can see.

decisions.choice: the spirit of a person: the inner self, aware of its own thoughts
decisions.reason: Paul uses the human spirit as an analogy. Just as only you know what is in your mind, only God's Spirit knows what is in God's. The comparison is about knowing from within; it does not say that God's Spirit relates to God exactly as the human spirit does to a person.

decisions.choice: {{gender:human beings|men}}; {{gender:person|man}}; {{gender:that person|him}}
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπων and ἀνθρώπου mean human beings in general, men and women alike. Literal keeps the nouns with the traditional forms as the alternative.

decisions.choice: what is going on inside someone (B); what someone is thinking (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the things of a person" are (m2), and need no gender setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:les humains|les hommes}}, {{gender:de l'être humain|de l'homme}}; "en lui" with no span
alternatives: {{gender:en cette personne|en lui}}, as the English
decisions.reason: The setting goes on the nouns. "Lui" refers back to "l'être humain", a masculine noun in both options, so it reads as generic and needs no span, where the English needs {{gender:that person|him}}.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}; en él, no span
decisions.reason: Spanish follows the English setting for the noun. Both "ser humano" and "hombre" are masculine words, so the pronoun "él" that refers back to them is the same in both options and needs no span of its own.

decisions.choice: no gender spans (wanadamu, mtu, yake)
alternatives: spans as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: "Wanadamu", "mtu" and the pronoun "yeye" with its possessive "yake" do not mark sex, so the English Literal's gender spans here and in verses 14–15 have nothing to switch in Swahili.

decisions.choice: roho ya mtu (lowercase, class 9)
decisions.reason: A person's own spirit is "roho" in lowercase with the agreement of a thing ("iliyo", "inayojua"); the Spirit of God in the next sentence is "Roho" with a capital and the personal agreement Swahili gives him ("Roho anachunguza"), so the two are kept apart.

decisions.choice: "tâm linh của người ấy", lowercase, for the human spirit; "người", "người ấy" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Tâm linh" is the word of the Vietnamese Romans 1:9 and 1 Thessalonians 5:23 for the human spirit, kept apart from "Thánh Linh", so Paul's comparison is visible: a person's own spirit, and God's Spirit (verse 11b). Vietnamese "người" is already man or woman, so no gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: "영" for the human spirit; "성령" and "하나님의 영" for the Spirit of God, at every level
decisions.reason: Paul compares the two, so Korean keeps the same word "영" for both, and "성령" (with the honorific) where the Spirit of God is meant.

source.text: οὕτως καὶ τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐδεὶς ἔγνωκεν εἰ μὴ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: So also the things of the God no one has known except the Spirit of the God.

en.L: So also no one has known the things of God except the Spirit of God.
en.B: In the same way, the things of God are known to no one but the Spirit of God.
en.R: In the same way, only God's Spirit knows what God is thinking.

fr.L: De même aussi, les choses de Dieu, personne ne les a connues, sinon l’Esprit de Dieu.
fr.B: De la même manière, les choses de Dieu ne sont connues de personne, sinon de l’Esprit de Dieu.
fr.R: De la même manière, seul l’Esprit de Dieu sait ce que pense Dieu.

sw.L: Vivyo hivyo pia hakuna aliyeyajua mambo ya Mungu isipokuwa Roho wa Mungu.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, mambo ya Mungu hayajulikani na mtu yeyote isipokuwa Roho wa Mungu.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, ni Roho wa Mungu peke yake anayejua mawazo ya Mungu.

es.L: Así también nadie ha conocido las cosas de Dios sino el Espíritu de Dios.
es.B: Del mismo modo, nadie conoce las cosas de Dios sino el Espíritu de Dios.
es.R: De la misma manera, solo el Espíritu de Dios sabe lo que Dios piensa.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, không ai đã biết những điều của Đức Chúa Trời ngoại trừ Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Cũng thế, không ai biết được những điều thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời ngoài Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, chỉ có Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời mới biết Đức Chúa Trời đang nghĩ gì.

ko.L: 이와 같이 하나님의 영 말고는 아무도 하나님의 일을 알지 못합니다.
ko.B: 마찬가지로 하나님의 일도 하나님의 영 말고는 아무도 알지 못합니다.
ko.R: 마찬가지로 하나님께서 무슨 생각을 하시는지는 하나님의 영만이 아십니다.

decisions.choice: has known: has come to know and so knows
decisions.reason: ἔγνωκεν is perfect: knowledge gained and held. Paul uses it as a present, "knows".

decisions.choice: the Spirit knows God from within
decisions.reason: The Spirit knows the things of God as a person's own spirit knows that person's thoughts. So what the Spirit reveals (verse 10) is God's own mind, not a guess about God. The Spirit belongs to God, not to the world (verse 12).

decisions.choice: what God is thinking
decisions.reason: Readable carries over the sense of the comparison in the previous sentence.

source.text: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ κόσμου ἐλάβομεν ἀλλὰ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα εἰδῶμεν τὰ ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ χαρισθέντα ἡμῖν·

records.literal_gloss: We however not the spirit of the world received but the Spirit the [one] from the God, so that we may know the things by the God having been freely given to us;

en.L: Now we did not receive the spirit of the world but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may know the things freely given to us by God.
en.B: We, for our part, have not received the spirit of the world. We have received the Spirit who comes from God, so that we may recognize all that God has graciously given us.
en.R: We have not been given the spirit that belongs to this world. God has given us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Spirit. Now we can understand all the good things God has freely given us.

fr.L: Or nous, nous n’avons pas reçu l’esprit du monde, mais l’Esprit qui vient de Dieu, afin que nous connaissions les choses qui nous ont été données gratuitement par Dieu.
fr.B: Nous, de notre côté, nous n’avons pas reçu l’esprit du monde. Nous avons reçu l’Esprit qui vient de Dieu, afin de reconnaître tout ce que Dieu nous a donné dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce.
fr.R: Nous n’avons pas reçu l’esprit qui appartient à ce monde. Dieu nous a donné {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Esprit. Maintenant, nous pouvons comprendre toutes les bonnes choses que Dieu nous a données gratuitement.

sw.L: Lakini sisi hatukuipokea roho ya ulimwengu, bali Roho aliyetoka kwa Mungu, ili tuyajue mambo tuliyokirimiwa na Mungu.
sw.B: Sisi, kwa upande wetu, hatukupokea roho ya ulimwengu. Tumempokea Roho anayetoka kwa Mungu, ili tutambue yote ambayo Mungu ametukirimia.
sw.R: Hatukupewa roho ya ulimwengu huu. Mungu ametupa Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. Sasa tunaweza kuelewa mambo yote mazuri ambayo Mungu ametupa bure.

es.L: Y nosotros no recibimos el espíritu del mundo, sino el Espíritu que [viene] de Dios, para que sepamos las cosas que Dios nos ha dado gratuitamente.
es.B: Nosotros, por nuestra parte, no hemos recibido el espíritu del mundo. Hemos recibido el Espíritu que viene de Dios, para que reconozcamos todo lo que Dios nos ha concedido por gracia.
es.R: No se nos ha dado el espíritu que pertenece a este mundo. Dios nos ha dado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Espíritu. Ahora podemos entender todas las cosas buenas que Dios nos ha dado gratuitamente.

vi.L: Còn chúng ta đã không nhận tinh thần của thế gian, nhưng nhận Thánh Linh đến từ Đức Chúa Trời, để chúng ta biết những điều Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho chúng ta cách nhưng không.
vi.B: Về phần chúng ta, chúng ta đã không nhận tinh thần của thế gian. Chúng ta đã nhận Thánh Linh đến từ Đức Chúa Trời, để nhận biết mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho chúng ta bởi ân điển.
vi.R: Chúng ta không nhận tinh thần thuộc về thế gian này. Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho chúng ta chính Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhờ đó, chúng ta có thể hiểu mọi điều tốt đẹp Đức Chúa Trời đã rộng rãi ban cho chúng ta.

ko.L: 우리는 세상의 영을 받지 않고 하나님에게서 [오신] 영을 받았습니다. 이는 하나님께서 우리에게 은혜로 주신 것들을 알게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 받은 것은 세상의 영이 아니라 하나님에게서 오신 성령입니다. 그래서 우리는 하나님께서 은혜로 우리에게 주신 모든 것을 알게 되었습니다.
ko.R: 우리가 받은 것은 이 세상에 속한 영이 아닙니다. 하나님께서는 우리에게 그분의 성령을 주셨습니다. 그래서 이제 우리는 하나님께서 우리에게 값없이 주신 모든 좋은 것을 깨달을 수 있습니다.

decisions.choice: we: all who believe, who received the Spirit when they came to faith
alternatives: Paul and his fellow preachers only
decisions.reason: In verses 6-7 "we speak" is Paul and those who preach with him. Receiving the Spirit is true of every believer (12:13; Galatians 3:2), so "we" here includes the Corinthians too. The aorist ἐλάβομεν points to the time they believed.

decisions.choice: the spirit of the world: the outlook and wisdom of humanity apart from God
alternatives: an evil spirit who rules the world
decisions.reason: The phrase is set against "the Spirit who is from God". κόσμου is the world of human beings turned away from God, whose wisdom did not know God (1:20-21). Paul can speak of a spirit at work in those who disobey (Ephesians 2:2), but here the contrast is mainly between two sources of understanding.

decisions.choice: freely given: gifts of God's grace, all that God gives in Christ
decisions.reason: χαρισθέντα is related to the word for grace. The things "freely given" are what God has prepared for those who love him (verse 9): salvation and everything that comes with it.

decisions.choice: graciously given
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the link to grace (m3); Literal and Readable say "freely given".

decisions.choice: God has given us his own Spirit
alternatives: the Spirit who is from God
decisions.reason: Readable names the giver and says plainly that the Spirit is God's.

decisions.choice: kukirimiwa (L); kukirimia (B)
decisions.reason: "Kukirimia" is to give generously as a free gift, the sense the meaning decision gives, without using "neema", which is kept for the Greek word for grace.

decisions.choice: "tinh thần của thế gian", lowercase, for "the spirit of the world"
decisions.reason: The world's spirit is its outlook (m2), not a being; "tinh thần" says that in Vietnamese, and keeps it apart from "Thánh Linh" in the same sentence.

source.text: ἃ καὶ λαλοῦμεν οὐκ ἐν διδακτοῖς ἀνθρωπίνης σοφίας λόγοις, ἀλλ’ ἐν διδακτοῖς πνεύματος, πνευματικοῖς πνευματικὰ συγκρίνοντες.

records.literal_gloss: which also we speak not in taught of human wisdom words but in [those] taught of Spirit, to spiritual [things] spiritual things interpreting.

en.L: These things we also speak, not in words taught by human wisdom but in [words] taught by [the] Spirit, interpreting spiritual things with spiritual [words].
en.B: When we speak of these things, our words are not lessons learned from human wisdom. The Spirit teaches them, and so we explain spiritual things in words the Spirit gives.
en.R: That is what we talk about. We do not use words that human wisdom has taught us. We use words that the Spirit has taught us. So we use the Spirit's words to explain the things that come from the Spirit.

fr.L: Et c’est de cela aussi que nous parlons, non avec des paroles enseignées par la sagesse humaine, mais avec [des paroles] enseignées par l’Esprit, interprétant les choses spirituelles par des [paroles] spirituelles.
fr.B: Quand nous parlons de ces choses, nos paroles ne sont pas des leçons apprises de la sagesse humaine. C’est l’Esprit qui nous les enseigne, et ainsi nous expliquons les choses spirituelles avec des paroles que donne l’Esprit.
fr.R: C’est de cela que nous parlons. Nous n’utilisons pas des mots que la sagesse humaine nous a appris. Nous utilisons des mots que l’Esprit nous a appris. Ainsi, nous expliquons avec les mots de l’Esprit les choses qui viennent de l’Esprit.

sw.L: Mambo hayo pia tunayanena, si kwa maneno yanayofundishwa na hekima ya kibinadamu, bali kwa [yale] yanayofundishwa na Roho, tukifasiri mambo ya kiroho kwa [maneno] ya kiroho.
sw.B: Tunaponena juu ya mambo hayo, maneno yetu si mafundisho tuliyojifunza kutoka kwa hekima ya kibinadamu. Roho ndiye anayetufundisha, na hivyo tunaeleza mambo ya kiroho kwa maneno ambayo Roho anatupa.
sw.R: Hayo ndiyo tunayozungumzia. Hatutumii maneno ambayo hekima ya kibinadamu imetufundisha. Tunatumia maneno ambayo Roho ametufundisha. Kwa hiyo tunatumia maneno ya Roho kueleza mambo yanayotoka kwa Roho.

es.L: Estas cosas también hablamos, no con palabras enseñadas por sabiduría humana, sino con [las] enseñadas por [el] Espíritu, interpretando lo espiritual con [palabras] espirituales.
es.B: Cuando hablamos de estas cosas, nuestras palabras no son lecciones aprendidas de la sabiduría humana. Es el Espíritu quien las enseña, y así explicamos lo espiritual con palabras que da el Espíritu.
es.R: De eso es de lo que hablamos. No usamos palabras que nos haya enseñado la sabiduría humana. Usamos palabras que el Espíritu nos ha enseñado. Así usamos las palabras del Espíritu para explicar las cosas que vienen del Espíritu.

vi.L: Những điều ấy chúng tôi cũng nói ra, không bằng những lời do sự khôn ngoan của loài người dạy, nhưng bằng [những lời] do Thánh Linh dạy, giải thích những điều thuộc linh bằng [những lời] thuộc linh.
vi.B: Khi nói về những điều ấy, lời của chúng tôi không phải là những bài học từ sự khôn ngoan của loài người. Thánh Linh dạy những lời ấy, nên chúng tôi giải thích những điều thuộc linh bằng những lời Thánh Linh ban cho.
vi.R: Đó là những điều chúng tôi nói ra. Chúng tôi không dùng những lời mà sự khôn ngoan của loài người đã dạy chúng tôi. Chúng tôi dùng những lời mà Thánh Linh đã dạy chúng tôi. Như vậy, chúng tôi dùng lời của Thánh Linh để giải thích những điều đến từ Thánh Linh.

ko.L: 우리는 이것을 사람의 지혜가 가르친 말로 하지 않고 성령께서 가르치신 [말]로 말합니다. 영적인 것을 영적인 [말]로 해석합니다.
ko.B: 우리가 이것을 말할 때, 우리는 사람의 지혜에서 배운 말을 쓰지 않습니다. 성령께서 가르쳐 주시는 말을 씁니다. 그래서 우리는 영적인 것을 성령께서 주시는 말로 설명합니다.
ko.R: 우리는 바로 이것에 대해 말합니다. 우리는 사람의 지혜가 가르쳐 준 말을 쓰지 않습니다. 성령께서 가르쳐 주신 말을 씁니다. 그래서 성령께서 주신 말로 성령께로부터 온 것들을 설명합니다.

decisions.choice: which we also speak: the gifts God has given (verse 12) are also what Paul preaches
decisions.reason: ἃ looks back to "the things freely given" in verse 12. Having received and understood them by the Spirit, Paul also speaks them.

decisions.choice: words taught by human wisdom, and words taught by the Spirit
decisions.reason: διδακτοῖς means "taught", and the genitives name the teacher: human wisdom in one case, the Spirit in the other. Paul is not saying the words fall from heaven; he is saying where his message and its way of speaking come from.

decisions.choice: spiritual things in spiritual words
alternatives: spiritual things with other spiritual things
decisions.reason: πνευματικοῖς can be neuter, "spiritual [words or things]", or masculine, "spiritual [people]". The neuter fits the sentence, which is about words; the masculine fits verses 14-15, which turn to the spiritual person. The difference is small: either way the Spirit gives both the message and the understanding.

decisions.choice: interpreting, explaining
decisions.reason: συγκρίνοντες usually means to combine or to compare (as in 2 Corinthians 10:12). In the Greek Old Testament it is used for interpreting dreams (Genesis 40-41), and that sense suits a sentence about how the gifts of God are put into words.

decisions.choice: the words are described in a sentence of their own
alternatives: in words not taught by human wisdom but taught by the Spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable unpack the compact Greek phrase into separate statements, so that it is clear who teaches the words (m2).

decisions.choice: spiritual things in words the Spirit gives (B); the Spirit's words to explain the things that come from the Spirit (R)
alternatives: interpreting spiritual things to spiritual people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the reading chosen in m3 and say that "spiritual" means from the Spirit; the footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: "thuộc linh" for pneumatikos (L, B), "những điều đến từ Thánh Linh" (R)
decisions.reason: "Thuộc linh" means "belonging to the Spirit", the sense here, and is the word of the Vietnamese Romans 7:14 and Galatians 6:1; "thiêng liêng" means sacred and "tâm linh" the human spirit. The same word is used for pneumatikos through the letter (2:15; 3:1; 12:1; 14:37; 15:44-46).

decisions.choice: "영적인" for the adjective at every level, through the letter; "영적인 사람" (L), "성령의 사람" (B), "성령을 모신 사람" (R) for the spiritual person in verse 15
decisions.reason: "영적인" is the current word; "신령한" is older and can suggest the supernatural or the occult.

source.text: Ψυχικὸς δὲ ἄνθρωπος οὐ δέχεται τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ θεοῦ, μωρία γὰρ αὐτῷ ἐστίν, καὶ οὐ δύναται γνῶναι, ὅτι πνευματικῶς ἀνακρίνεται·

records.literal_gloss: Natural however man not accepts the things of the Spirit of the God, foolishness for to him it is, and not he is able to know, because spiritually it is examined;

en.L: But [the] {{gender:natural person|natural man}} does not accept the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to {{gender:that person|him}}, and {{gender:that person is|he is}} not able to know [them], because they are examined spiritually.
en.B: A person who has only natural life does not welcome what belongs to the Spirit of God. It all seems foolish to such a person, who cannot grasp it, because it can be weighed rightly only by the Spirit.
en.R: People who do not have God's Spirit will not accept the things that come from the Spirit. They think these things are foolish. They cannot understand them, because only the Spirit can help people see what these things really mean.

fr.L: Or {{gender:l’être humain naturel|l’homme naturel}} n’accepte pas les choses de l’Esprit de Dieu, car elles sont folie pour lui, et il ne peut pas [les] connaître, parce que c’est spirituellement qu’elles sont examinées.
fr.B: Une personne qui n’a que la vie naturelle n’accueille pas ce qui vient de l’Esprit de Dieu. Tout cela lui paraît une folie, et elle ne peut pas le comprendre, parce qu’on ne peut en juger correctement que par l’Esprit.
fr.R: Les gens qui n’ont pas l’Esprit de Dieu n’acceptent pas les choses qui viennent de l’Esprit. Ils pensent que ce sont des folies. Ils ne peuvent pas les comprendre, parce que seul l’Esprit peut aider les gens à voir ce que ces choses veulent vraiment dire.

sw.L: Lakini mtu wa asili hayapokei mambo ya Roho wa Mungu, kwa maana kwake ni upumbavu, wala hawezi kuyajua, kwa sababu yanachunguzwa kiroho.
sw.B: Mtu aliye na uhai wa asili tu hayakaribishi mambo ya Roho wa Mungu. Kwake yote yanaonekana upumbavu, naye hawezi kuyaelewa, kwa sababu yanaweza kupimwa ipasavyo kwa msaada wa Roho peke yake.
sw.R: Watu wasio na Roho wa Mungu hawayakubali mambo yanayotoka kwa Roho. Wanaona kwamba mambo hayo ni upumbavu. Hawawezi kuyaelewa, kwa sababu ni Roho peke yake anayeweza kuwasaidia watu kuona maana halisi ya mambo hayo.

es.L: Pero {{gender:el ser humano natural|el hombre natural}} no acepta las cosas del Espíritu de Dios, porque para él son necedad, y no [las] puede conocer, porque se examinan espiritualmente.
es.B: Quien tiene solo la vida natural no recibe lo que es del Espíritu de Dios. Todo le parece necedad, y no puede entenderlo, porque solo se puede evaluar rectamente por medio del Espíritu.
es.R: Las personas que no tienen el Espíritu de Dios no aceptan las cosas que vienen del Espíritu. Piensan que esas cosas son una tontería. No las pueden entender, porque solo el Espíritu puede ayudar a la gente a ver lo que realmente significan.

vi.L: Nhưng người tự nhiên không tiếp nhận những điều của Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời, vì những điều ấy là sự dại dột đối với người ấy, và người ấy không thể biết [được], vì những điều ấy được xem xét cách thuộc linh.
vi.B: Người chỉ có sự sống tự nhiên không đón nhận những gì thuộc về Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời. Đối với người ấy, mọi điều đó đều có vẻ dại dột, và người ấy không thể hiểu được, vì chỉ nhờ Thánh Linh mới có thể đánh giá những điều ấy cho đúng.
vi.R: Những người không có Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời sẽ không chấp nhận những điều đến từ Thánh Linh. Họ cho những điều ấy là dại dột. Họ không thể hiểu được, vì chỉ có Thánh Linh mới giúp người ta thấy được ý nghĩa thật của những điều ấy.

ko.L: 그러나 자연적인 사람은 하나님의 영의 일들을 받아들이지 않습니다. 그것이 그에게는 어리석음이기 때문입니다. 그리고 그는 [그것을] 알 수 없습니다. 그것은 영적으로 살펴야 하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 타고난 생명만 가진 사람은 하나님의 영에 속한 일들을 받아들이지 않습니다. 그런 사람에게는 그것이 모두 어리석게 보이고, 그는 그것을 깨달을 수도 없습니다. 그것은 성령으로만 바르게 판단할 수 있기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 하나님의 영이 없는 사람들은 성령께서 주시는 것들을 받아들이지 않습니다. 그들은 그런 것들을 어리석다고 생각합니다. 그들은 그것을 이해할 수 없습니다. 그것이 정말 무슨 뜻인지는 성령께서 도와주셔야만 알 수 있기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: a natural person: someone who has only ordinary human life, without the Spirit of God
alternatives: a person ruled by the senses
the soul as a lower part of a person
decisions.reason: Ψυχικὸς comes from ψυχή, "life, soul": it describes life as people have it by nature. Paul sets it against πνευματικὸς ("spiritual") here and in 15:44-46, where the natural body is set against the spiritual body. Jude 19 describes people as natural, "not having the Spirit". Paul is not dividing a person into soul and spirit; he contrasts life without God's Spirit and life with it.

decisions.choice: does not accept: refuses to welcome as true
decisions.reason: δέχεται means to receive or welcome, as a guest or a message (1 Thessalonians 1:6; 2:13). Such a person hears but does not welcome the message.

decisions.choice: foolishness: the same verdict the world passes on the message of the cross
decisions.reason: μωρία takes up 1:18 and 1:23, where the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing.

decisions.choice: examined spiritually: weighed and judged rightly only with the Spirit's help
decisions.reason: ἀνακρίνω means to examine or question closely, as a judge does at a hearing (Acts 4:9). It recurs in verse 15 and in 4:3-4, where Paul refuses to be judged by the Corinthians. πνευματικῶς ("spiritually") means by means of the Spirit.

decisions.choice: {{gender:natural person|natural man}}; {{gender:that person|him}}; {{gender:that person is|he is}}
decisions.reason: ἄνθρωπος means a human being, man or woman. Literal keeps the singular with the traditional forms as the alternative; Balanced says "person" and Readable "people", which need no setting.

decisions.choice: a person who has only natural life (B); people who do not have God's Spirit (R)
decisions.reason: "Natural" alone suggests something healthy or unprocessed, and "soulish" is not English. Balanced keeps the idea of natural life; Readable says what is missing (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:l'être humain naturel|l'homme naturel}}; "pour lui", "il ne peut pas" with no span
alternatives: {{gender:pour cette personne|pour lui}}, as the English
